texts.Core_ErrorDigest_NotScheduled: Not scheduled: no digest is sent.

texts.Core_ErrorDigest_ReadOnly: You can see the error digest but not change it. Ask for the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.

texts.Core_Transform_ErrorNeedsTest: If, then needs a test: equals, contains or is empty.
texts.Core_Transform_ErrorNeedsText: Find and replace needs the text to find.
texts.Core_Transform_ErrorNeedsValue: Value when empty needs a value.
texts.Core_Transform_ErrorPart: Keep part needs a separator (at most 10 characters) and a part from 1 to {0}.
texts.Core_Transform_ErrorShift: Shift a date needs days or months and a whole number of them (at most 36600 days or 1200 months either way).
texts.Core_Transform_ErrorTooLong: Text in a change can be at most 255 characters, and a separator at most 10.
texts.Core_Transform_ErrorTooMany: A value can have at most {0} changes.
texts.Core_Transform_ErrorUnknown: "{0}" is not a change BarnCRM knows. Remove it and choose one from the list.
texts.Core_WhatsNew_Failed: What's new could not be updated. Refresh the page and try again. The problem is recorded in the Error Log.
texts.Core_WhatsNew_Intro: Here is what changed since you last dismissed this card.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_NoneObject: No BarnCRM setup uses this kind of record.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_RetireIntro: BarnCRM never deletes a field. Work down these steps to retire it safely; the ticks are only for you and are not saved.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepBackup: Back up the values: open Find on this kind of record, add the field as a column and export.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepDelete: Delete the field in Setup. Salesforce keeps it under Deleted Fields for 15 days.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepHide: Hide the field first: take it off page layouts and remove field access for a few weeks, to learn whether anyone misses it.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepReferences: Edit or remove each BarnCRM setup record listed above.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepSalesforce: Check Salesforce's own uses: open the field in Setup and click Where is this used?
